sections.title: 5. Redundant Computations
Priority Summary
sections.content:
| Issue | File | Impact | Effort |
|-------|------|--------|--------|
| Sequential Yahoo + DB writes | `refresh-prices/route.ts` | High — 5x+ slower | Low |
| `force-dynamic` on dashboard API | `dashboard/home/route.ts` | High — 12 DB queries every visit | Low |
| Missing `useMemo` on derived data | `DashboardHome.tsx`, `FinanceClient.tsx` | Medium — extra renders on task toggle | Low |
| `Intl.NumberFormat` per call | Both client files | Low — JIT usually optimizes this | Trivial |

The two highest-ROI fixes are the `refresh-prices` parallelization and switching the dashboard API from `force-dynamic` to `revalidate = 60`.
